scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w backend && node backend/dist/deploy-cli.js && npm run build -w frontend
